summary: Implementation plan to resolve the Facebook Live Producer loading stall. Root cause analysis confirms Facebook connects to the RTMP stream but stalls during preview because: 1) RECORD_AUDIO permission was not requested at runtime, leaving the audio pipeline dead and starving Facebook of required AAC frames; 2) Continuous synthetic audio carrier was missing when mic input is silent; 3) Periodic IDR sync frames and timestamps need stabilization when the app is backgrounded while the user checks Facebook Live Producer in Chrome.
